description: Algorithmic placeholder per Item #10 R2 lock: per-grade-per-band priors generated from a discrete Gaussian peaked at the grade's mid-of-band theta, std dev = 2 level-steps (where one step = 6/17 in theta-space). Bands are the 6 Atlas diagnostic bands locked in Item #12 (number_sense, operations_algorithms, fractions_decimals, measurement, geometry, data_statistics); the algorithm is band-agnostic, so the Item #12 taxonomy migration required no recalibration here — engine re-keying happened transitively through STRANDS in levels.ts. Same algorithm applied to all 6 bands within a grade — band-specific divergence is a v2 concern. Replace with empirical priors (cf. roadmap/v2-progress-tracking.md feature 16) once approximately 200-300 responses per item exist. priors.ts validates this file with zod at module load and expands it into a full per-grade-per-band EnginePriorConfig.
